label: Direct per-se conservation of esse: Preservation under which the preserved creature depends for…
definition: Preservation under which the preserved creature depends for its being on the preserver's continuing esse-giving action. In q.104 a.1 the divine action is not a new production at each temporal instant and is described as without motion or time. This source definition neither stipulates a Lean relation nor equates every nonexistence counterfactual with a cause.
